standard_20_bin.intact_element_bias_description: Bin 19 centers at 19.5/20 = 0.975, introducing a systematic 2.5% stiffness drop on undamaged bulk.

intact_anchored_20_bin.description: Anchors d < 0.01 elements to exact E0 (g=1.0), reducing bulk error to 0.0% and confining bin error strictly to the softening corridor.

high_fidelity_100_bin.description: Anchors intact elements to E0 and uses 100 fine bins across the softening zone.

exact_elementwise.description: Assigns each element its exact constitutive degradation factor g_d = (1-d)^2 + k_res.
